title: Wealth Management Careers Coach
description:
Leland is building the home for ambition in the age of AI. We connect people with the experts, programs, and communities they need to land the job, get into the school, or upskill for a world being rewritten by AI. We help businesses become AI-native through training, hiring, and infrastructure. Since our founding in 2021, we've helped tens of thousands of people reach their most ambitious goals and raised $19M from world-class investors. Ambition is sacred to us, and we've built a product that takes that seriously.
We're seeking an experienced wealth management careers coach to work with students and professionals pursuing careers in wealth management. This role includes teaching core skills in financial planning, investment strategy, retirement planning, estate planning, and tax planning, as well as guiding students in applying AI fundamentals and AI automation to modern wealth management work. Coaches also support the career side of the journey, including resume review, cover letters, LinkedIn review, interview prep, and salary negotiation, as well as promotion strategy, networking strategy, and freelancing for those pursuing independent work. Ideal candidates have professional experience in wealth management, prior coaching or mentoring experience, and a clear, structured approach to breaking down financial and career topics alike. Coaches set their own hours and rates, host sessions virtually, and partner with our team to deliver a high-quality, supportive experience for every student.
Why Leland ?

• The chance to join a world-class team helping people achieve their career and educational dreams

• Work in a collaborative, high-energy environment where your contributions have a direct impact

• Operate in a fast-paced, AI-native environment

• We don't hire people who merely want to work for a great company; we hire people who want to make a great company

Leland is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds and demographics to apply.

title: Fire Dispatcher - Emergency Communications Specialist
description:
Role Title: Fire Dispatcher - Emergency Communications Specialist
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote
micro1 is selecting Fire Dispatcher - Emergency Communications Specialists to contribute their operational expertise to a dynamic customer project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required - your domain knowledge is what matters. This is an opportunity for seasoned fire dispatch professionals to share their practical knowledge of prioritizing and routing emergency requests while applying standardized protocols in high-pressure environments. Expertise in both written and verbal communication will be essential in providing clear, actionable feedback and data for AI development.
Scope of Work

• Receive and analyze simulated or real-time emergency requests, determining urgency and allocating appropriate resources based on established protocols.

• Apply triage skills to prioritize incoming information from multiple communication channels, ensuring timely and accurate routing.

• Utilize standardized checklists and dispatching scripts to maintain procedural consistency and compliance with best practices.

• Document scenario responses and communication flows in a clear and structured format for AI system learning.

• Evaluate, critique, and suggest improvements to protocols or automated responses generated by AI models.

• Collaborate with project coordinators to ensure project deliverables meet quality standards and operational objectives.

• Provide concise feedback regarding the effectiveness and clarity of AI-generated communications.

Preferred Qualifications

• Significant experience as a fire dispatcher, emergency communications specialist, or equivalent.

• Exceptional multitasking abilities, including managing simultaneous requests via radio, phone, and digital platforms.

• Proficiency in applying, following, and interpreting standardized emergency protocols and checklists( APCO/NENA certification).

• Demonstrated capacity for clear, concise, and professional written and verbal communication.

• Ability to work effectively under pressure and make rapid, accurate prioritization decisions.

• Familiarity with the unique challenges and workflows of emergency dispatch environments.

• Experience contributing to training, evaluation, or improvement of operational procedures is a plus.

title: Solutions Architect, Frontier Engineering
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake Frontier Engineeringは、Snowflakeプラットフォームの実装・戦略組織です。私たちはお客様のジャーニー全体を通じて、最適化・加速・ビジネス成果の実現を支援します。

私たちは、Snowflake Frontier Engineeringとお客様の間の重要な技術的橋渡し役を担うソリューションアーキテクトを求めています。このロールは、深いプラットフォーム専門知識とコンサルティング型セールスの能力を組み合わせ、プリセールスサイクルにおけるハンズオン技術リーダーシップを提供しながら、戦略的エンゲージメントにおける直接的な顧客デリバリーへの副次的な責任も担います。

理想的な候補者は、複雑な顧客のビジネス課題を、実現可能で説得力のあるSnowflakeソリューションに変換し、技術者および経営層の両方に自信を持ってそのビジョンを伝えることができます。

ソリューションアーキテクトとしてのあなたの役割

- Frontier Engineering プラクティスマネージャーおよびプラクティスディレクターをサービスセールスサイクル全体にわたって支援する主要技術リソースとして機能します。

- Snowflakeの顧客要件への対応能力を検証し、商談のクローズを加速させるための技術ディスカバリーセッション、ソリューションデザインワークショップ、アーキテクチャレビュー、概念実証（PoC）を主導します。

- Snowflakeプラットフォームの機能に基づいた、デリバリー可能なソリューションの全体アーキテクチャを設計します。

- 作業範囲定義書（SOW）に直接反映されるソリューションアーキテクチャ、工数見積もり、リソース計画、リスク評価などの技術スコーピング成果物を作成します。

- ディレクター、VP、CTO、CDOを含む顧客技術ステークホルダーとのトラステッドアドバイザー関係を構築します。

- 競争ポジショニング、技術的異論への対処、価値の明確化、拡張機会の特定を通じて、サービス案件の品質と受注率を向上させる技術的ソートリーダーシップを提供します。

- 主にソリューションアーキテクトが発案したエンゲージメント、短期のアーキテクチャ検証スプリント、または戦略的アカウントにおける経営層レベルのチェックポイントセッションへ選択的に参加します。

- 再利用可能なソリューションパターン、リファレンスアーキテクチャ、セールス資料、イネーブルメントコンテンツの作成に貢献します。

- プラクティスマネージャーへの技術的ポジショニング指導、テクニカルアーキテクトへの顧客向けコミュニケーションスキル指導を行います。

- 顧客要件、競争ギャップ、新興市場ニーズについてプロダクトマネジメントおよびエンジニアリングに構造化されたフィードバックを提供します。

- このロールは、フルタイムの実装ロールではありません。デリバリーへの関与は時間制限があり意図的であり、プラットフォームへの精通を維持しながらセールスサイクル中に構築した顧客関係を強化することを目的としています。

理想的なソリューションアーキテクトが備える能力・経験

- プリセールスおよび/またはポストセールスコンサルティング、ソリューションアーキテクチャ、または技術アドバイザリーにわたる顧客向け技術ロールでの5年以上の経験。

- 案件追求を支援しながら技術プロジェクト業務を遂行する、セールスとデリバリーの交差点での業務経験。

- 技術者および経営層に向けたエンタープライズ規模のデータプラットフォームソリューションの設計・提案の実績。

- 日本のビジネスセールスサイクル（要件収集、RFP前のセールス活動、正式なRFPプロセスと対応）における実証された経験。

- データアナリティクス、データエンジニアリング、またはAI/MLソリューション開発の文脈でのSQLおよびPythonの実践的な習熟度。

- AWS、Azure、またはGCPのいずれか主要なパブリッククラウドプラットフォームへの深い理解。

- 工数見積もり、ソリューションアーキテクチャ文書化、SOW作成を含むFrontier Engineeringスコーピングの経験。

- データモデリング、ETL/ELTパターン、データガバナンス、モダンデータアーキテクチャパターンへの深い理解。

- ホワイトボードでのチョークトーク、フォーマルなピッチ、ライブデモンストレーションなど、様々な場面での優れたプレゼンテーションスキル。

- 顧客、パートナー、およびすべてのレベルの社内ステークホルダーとの信頼関係を築く卓越した対人スキル。

- Systems Integratorとの協働を含むパートナーエコシステムの経験。

- コンピューターサイエンス、エンジニアリング、データサイエンス、数学、または関連分野の大学学位、または同等の職業経験。

- 日本語ネイティブレベルおよびビジネスレベルの英語能力。(Native Japanese and Business level English)

- 必要に応じて顧客先へのオンサイト訪問のための出張に対応できる柔軟性。

以下に当てはまる方は特に歓迎します

- コンサルティングまたは実装の立場でのSnowflakeまたは同等のクラウドデータプラットフォームの経験。

- Snowflake SnowPro CoreおよびAdvanced認定資格。

- 金融サービス、ヘルスケア、小売、メディア、製造などの主要業界における業界専門知識。

- モデル開発、デプロイメント、MLOpsプラクティスを含むAI/MLライフサイクルの概念への精通。

- Teradata、Hadoop、Netezzaなどのレガシープラットフォームのモダナイゼーションを含むデータマイグレーション方法論の経験。

- AWS、Google、またはMicrosoftのクラウド認定資格。

JAPAN BENEFIT

title: Security Systems Technical Lead
description:
Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Security Systems Technical Lead to be embedded on our client’s Security Technology team.

The Technical Lead will provide expertise and direction for the design, deployment, optimization, and ongoing health of enterprise physical security technology. This role supports complex security systems initiatives, evaluates and improves existing technologies and processes, and serves as a key technical partner to security, IT, engineering, and vendor teams. The Technical Lead will oversee solutions from requirements and design through implementation and operational support, while identifying opportunities to improve system reliability, scalability, lifecycle management, and overall security program effectiveness.

This is a full-time, fully remote position offering a comprehensive benefits package.

Responsibilities

• Lead the planning, technical execution, and delivery of enterprise physical security technology projects, including PACS, VMS, video analytics, and related security infrastructure.

• Own projects from requirements gathering and technical design through testing, deployment, commissioning, and operational handoff.

• Develop project plans, schedules, milestones, and technical requirements while managing dependencies, risks, and resource needs.

• Evaluate existing security systems and develop remediation strategies to improve system health, reliability, performance, and operational effectiveness.

• Provide technical leadership for system migrations, upgrades, integrations, and lifecycle initiatives across on-premises, hybrid, and SaaS environments.

• Perform or oversee system configuration, provisioning, integration testing, troubleshooting, and issue resolution across enterprise security platforms.

• Review technical designs, system architectures, device configurations, and infrastructure requirements to ensure solutions meet security, operational, and enterprise standards.

• Partner with security operations, IT, engineering, vendors, and other stakeholders to align technical solutions with business and operational requirements.

• Identify opportunities to improve security technology processes, system lifecycle management, and operational workflows through standardization and automation.

• Develop technical documentation, SOPs, implementation plans, and recommendations that support sustainable system operations and continuous improvement.

Required

• 10+ years of experience designing, implementing, supporting, or managing enterprise physical security systems and technologies.

• Strong technical expertise with Physical Access Control Systems (PACS), Video Management Systems (VMS), badging, and related technologies.

• Hands-on experience with enterprise platforms such as Lenel OnGuard, C•CURE 9000, Genetec Security Center, or comparable systems.

• Demonstrated experience with system migrations, integrations, upgrades, commissioning, and lifecycle management.

• Strong understanding of security system architecture, networking, databases, servers, and cloud/hybrid environments.

• Proven ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues, assess system health, identify root causes, and develop remediation strategies.

• Strong project coordination and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple technical initiatives, priorities, and dependencies.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across security, IT, engineering, vendors, and other stakeholders.

title: Langfuse - Senior Product Engineer
description:
WHY PRODUCT ENGINEERING AT LANGFUSE

Your work will have an outsized impact.

Everything you build is open source (MIT-licensed) and immediately visible. Langfuse has 21,900+ GitHub stars and our SDKs are downloaded 23M+ times per month. When you ship a new feature the community notices in GitHub issues, on X, and in our community channels.

Product engineers at Langfuse are the people who deliver new features end-to-end to our users. You own the product thinking from understanding the user problem to deciding what to build to shipping the solution.

You will also have direct exposure to how cutting-edge LLM applications are built. The users you serve are some of the best and most ambitious software engineers leveraging Langfuse to improve their applications. Deeply understanding the problems they solve will help you design the best possible product and along the way makes you an expert on LLM engineering yourself.

 

YOU WILL GROW AT LANGFUSE BY

- Own features end-to-end: from talking to users, to writing the spec, to shipping the code and docs, to writing the changelog post https://langfuse.com/changelog with your name on it. To give you a sense: recent features a single engineer owned include the Langfuse for Agents https://langfuse.com/changelog/2025-11-05-langfuse-for-agents release (new trace views, agent graphs, semantic span labels), the TypeScript SDK v4 https://langfuse.com/changelog/2025-08-28-typescript-sdk-v4-ga rewrite on OpenTelemetry, and the hosted MCP server https://langfuse.com/changelog/2025-11-20-hosted-mcp-server for prompt management.

- Work across the full stack: and we mean full. Our surface area is wide: React frontend, Next.js backend, ClickHouse analytics, Python and TypeScript SDKs, public docs, Terraform modules, and more. You'll touch whatever the feature needs. One week you might be writing a new ClickHouse query for cost analytics, the next you're designing an SDK API, the next you're building a new React view for agent traces.

- Talk to users constantly: jump on calls, respond in community channels, and route support requests. At Langfuse, support is how we build conviction about what to build next. Our handbook says it best: support by engineers is a core value proposition.

- Write public documentation about the features you own. At Langfuse, docs are product.

- Ship publicly during Launch Weeks: we've run four Launch Weeks https://langfuse.com/blog/2025-10-29-launch-week-4 so far, dropping a new feature every day for a week. Engineers present the features they built to the community.

 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- Someone who has built features or even entire products from scratch end-to-end

- Experience building and shipping user-facing products end-to-end, ideally in TypeScript/React and with exposure to data-intensive backends

- Someone who can manage projects themselves. You know how to develop strong conviction about what to build and how to ship it.

- Taste for great developer experience: you care about API design, UI details, and clear documentation

- Interest in open source software and genuine excitement about talking to developers about their problems

- Thrives in a small, accountable team where your output is visible and matters

- CS or quantitative degree preferred

Bonus points:

- Experience with ClickHouse, analytics databases, or building complex data visualizations

- Former founder or early startup experience

- Contributions to popular open source projects

- ML/AI background or familiarity with the LLM framework ecosystem

No candidate checks all boxes. If you feel you are a good fit for this role, please go ahead and apply.

 

PERKS

- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

- Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

- Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

- Time off - Flexible time off i

title: Global Care Navigator - Netherlands
description:
Our mission: e liminating every barrier to mental health.

Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.

Our AI-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners.

As an AI-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission.

We are looking for a Care Navigator/Support Coordinator to join our team! Masters degree in a behavioral health field and licensure or certification as a counselor, social worker, or psychotherapist, psychologist required. Fully bilingual (written and spoken) in both English and Dutch. Additional language(s) fluency such as spoken and written Portuguese, Spanish etc. is a plus!

They have creative problem-solving skills and a passion for delivering a high-quality experience. This role will report to the Manager of the Global Team in Clinical Operations.

• Assess and synthesize information using good clinical judgment to manage member crises such as suicide risk by providing in-the-moment support, triage, safety planning, and follow up.

• Provide consultation, psycho-education, empathy and motivational assistance as needed to address mental health, substance use, and family/relationship concerns.

• Engage in CIR intake and/or coaching services for global members and customers

• Identify and problem-solve issues that serve as a barrier or disruption to care, technical issues, and more submitted by members and providers.

• Research and document crisis resources for members in different countries

• Review and learn from current and new workflows, via a combination of online and live training, and policies, which will be written and spoken in English.

• Summarize all patient interactions, writing in English within Spring Health ’s online documentation systems.

• Coordinate with other internal teams in identifying, reporting, and resolving issues as needed, to ensure a smooth member experience.

• Participate in staff meetings, case consultations, training, and special internal projects such as customer-facing initiatives as assigned and available.

• Follow Spring Health policies and maintain all confidentiality, compliance, and ethical standards.

title: Lead Full Stack Developer
description:

This is a strong opportunity for an engineer who wants to work close to an experienced founder, build meaningful AI product features, and help shape the architecture of a growing platform rather than simply maintain another standard SaaS application.
﻿

title: Project Manager
description:
About Us

We are a modern marketing collective built for scale, efficiency, and impact. As the parent company, Agital supports three specialized agencies: Go Fish Digital , REQ, and WDG, with shared infrastructure, advanced technology, and deeply experienced people, allowing each brand to do its best work.

Go Fish Digital is an engineering-forward performance marketing agency specializing in SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), its Barracuda AI platform, social commerce, and conversion-focused creative.

WDG designs and builds complex enterprise web experiences for associations, nonprofits, foundations, universities, and other mission-driven organizations.

REQ is a digital marketing and communications agency specializing in brand, reputation, and advocacy for global organizations across technology, healthcare, finance, hospitality, and real estate.

Together, we operate as one collaborative ecosystem, combining deep expertise, AI-powered capabilities, and a culture of curiosity to help ambitious brands grow while creating meaningful opportunities for our people.

About the Role

Go Fish Digital is where digital marketing meets clarity, creativity, and scale. As our agency grows and our client engagements become increasingly complex and cross-functional, strong project management is essential to ensuring great strategy turns into great execution.

The Project Manager serves as the operational backbone of assigned client work. This person creates the structure that allows Client Strategy and delivery teams to execute effectively, turning priorities and decisions into clear tasks, realistic timelines, coordinated resources, and measurable progress.

You will work across teams to keep complex client work moving, identify risks before they become problems, and create the visibility teams need to deliver on time and profitably.

What You'll Do

You will own the execution system for a portfolio of complex client accounts and projects.

You will partner closely with Client Strategy and delivery teams to translate approved strategy into actionable work, coordinate timelines and dependencies, maintain clear project plans, and ensure teams have the information and capacity needed to deliver.

You will not own the client relationship or service strategy. Instead, you will create operational discipline around those functions, making sure decisions turn into action, risks surface early, and commitments remain realistic.

Your involvement will vary based on the complexity of the account or project. On some engagements, you may be deeply embedded in internal planning and execution; on others, you may provide lighter project governance and periodic oversight. Go Fish intentionally uses a tiered PM model based on account complexity, revenue impact, coordination burden, timeline risk, capacity needs, and margin exposure.

Key Functions

Project Planning and Execution

• Translate approved strategy and project decisions into clear work plans, tasks, milestones, dependencies, owners, and timelines.

• Build and maintain realistic project schedules that reflect scope, priorities, team capacity, and delivery dependencies.

• Monitor execution, adjust plans as conditions change, and ensure decisions consistently move into action.

• Maintain strong project structure in ClickUp so teams understand what needs to happen, who owns it, and when it is due.

title: AWS DevOps Engineer (Associate)
description:
Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores ' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60-70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract.
This role sits in our Application & Database Modernization pillar: moving legacy applications, databases, and infrastructure from on-premises to cloud-native AWS on committed dates. Customers come to us with dedicated hardware that costs more every year, deployments that depend on one person's memory, and enterprise workloads- Linux, Windows, big data that nobody wants to touch.
You'll join the DevOps team that lands these migrations. Aedeon handles the discovery and dependency-mapping grind; you build the automation, monitoring, and CI infrastructure that makes each cutover repeatable and safe. This is a client-facing engineering role: you'll set customer expectations, meet them, and see your infrastructure work carry production traffic.
What you will do?

• Deliver application migration projects from on-premises to AWS.

• Deliver database migration projects RDBMS, NoSQL, DW, Hadoop from on-premises to AWS.

• Automate operational and server provisioning workflows using AWS CFT on AWS.

• Share responsibility for deploying releases and running operations maintenance.

• Improve operations infrastructure: Jenkins clusters, Bitbucket, monitoring tools (Consul), and metrics tools such as Graphite and Grafana.

• Provide operational support for the rest of the engineering team.

• Help migrate our remaining dedicated hardware infrastructure to the cloud retire the legacy, don't babysit it.

• Establish and maintain operational best practices, and implement monitoring for automated system health checks.

• Build our CI pipeline, and train and guide the team in DevOps practices.

What do you have?

• 2+ years of experience using Terraform for IaaC.

• 2+ years of configuration management and engineering for large-scale customers, ideally supporting an Agile development process.

• 2+ years of Linux administration experience.

• Deep understanding of version control systems (git), including branching and merging strategies.

• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/EC2/ECS/RDS/CloudFormation, CloudWatch, etc.) and cloud automation tools (Ansible, Chef).

• Experience with software build tools (Maven, Gradle) and continuous integration tools (Jenkins).

• Production support experience with Java-based applications - this one's a must.

• Experience with Linux environments and scripting languages: bash, Python, Groovy.

• Experience supporting Node.js in production is a plus.

• Knowledge of service discovery tools such as Consul is a plus.

• Comfort working late evening hours, which is when most patching occurs.

• A proactive eye for what can be made more reliable - and the follow-through to make it so.

You will be preferred if

• You are AWS DevOps Pro or AWS SA Pro Certified
How we work?
We run a forward-deployed model. Engineers embed with the customer's team, own outcomes from discovery through production, and carry the delivery commitment personally. Aedeon absorbs scale; engineers absorb judgment; the contract absorbs risk. As an associate, that structure works in your favor: the repetitive discovery work is largely absorbed by agents, so your hours go to automation, infrastructure, and learning cutover discipline from senior engineers. The culture is casual and steers clear of rigid corporate habits. We care about what ships.

Life at Mactores

We care about creating a culture that makes a real difference

A proud member of the Quanta Services family of companies, Ampacity, LLC (Ampacity) delivers a forward-thinking approach to structural and electrical solutions for clean energy transition projects. From design, kitting, and installation to comprehensive electrical procurement, Ampacity specializes in expert-engineered, field-ready solutions that accelerate project timelines and maximize impact. Made up of more than 350 passionate professionals committed to simplifying complexity across the energy value chain, Ampacity empowers customers to build smarter, faster, and more efficiently­-with the most reliable technology in the industry. Headquartered in California, Ampacity maintains facilities in Mississippi, Kentucky, and Iowa, with offices in Florida, Georgia, and Vermont. Ampacity is seeking a Sales Operations Associate to support the sales team by keeping contracts, sales orders, and project handoffs organized and on track. You'll help maintain sales reports, track forecasts, and coordinate between Sales, Operations, and Finance to make sure customer projects move forward without delays.
This is a great entry point into sales operations. You'll learn how a sales team runs day to day, build skills in reporting and process management, and work closely with experienced sales leaders. What You'll Bring

• 0-2 years of experience in sales support, sales operations, or administrative roles (internships count)

• Comfortable working with data and spreadsheets (Excel proficiency)

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

• Clear written and verbal communication

• Ability to juggle multiple tasks and deadlines at once

• Proactive follow-through and comfortable chasing down missing information

• Basic understanding of sales processes and contract workflows, or willingness to learn quickly
What You'll Get

• Competitive pay and 401k - because your work should be rewarded fairly

• Time off you'll actually use: vacation, sick days, holidays, parental, and bereavement leave

• Full medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus extra support when you need it

• Wellness resources to help you show up as your best self, at work and at home

• Real room to grow - we promote from within and invest in your development

The role

We are seeking a dynamic, hands-on Senior Product Delivery Manager at HelloFresh. This role is pivotal to the future of our fulfillment network. You will be at the helm of further developing and deploying a high-profile, highly complex strategic project that fundamentally redefines our production methods and capabilities across our DCs.
Working closely with Tech and Operations Leadership, you will be responsible for taking our new, next-generation production setup and refining its processes, equipment, and layouts. Once optimized, you will lead the charge in deploying this new operational blueprint into other DCs across our international markets.
This is not a traditional desk-bound product role; it requires a strong operational background, deep understanding of physical process design, and the ability to bridge the gap between high-level strategy and on-the-ground execution. The international role will be based in our Berlin office and will involve frequent travel to our local warehouses across markets and potentially extended stays during roll-out periods.

Above all, we are looking for people who will  make HelloFresh   better.  We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

• Strategy and Planning: You will support the development of rollout strategies and produce the resulting project plans, ensuring that we deploy at scale without disrupting ongoing operations.

• Documentation and Standardization: You will drive towards clear and structured project documentation, clearly defining and outlining the solutions, requirements, … You will help us create standard deployment playbooks which speed up bringing our solutions to market.

What you’ll bring

• Experience: You have a strong track record within a production, manufacturing, or supply chain environment.

• Academic Record: An excellent academic record with a degree from a top-tier college or University (Engineering, Supply Chain, or Business degrees strongly preferred).

Senior Account Executive
Most AE roles are about selling marginal improvements. This role is about bringing a differentiated SaaS offering focused on Data Monetization to the market. Revelate has built the foundational infrastructure that enables large organizations to treat data as a revenue-generating asset. We are looking for a highly motivated sales professional with a strong ownership mentality to expand our market presence and acquire new clients within large and mid-size enterprises.
The Context
Our customers have invested heavily in platforms like Snowflake. They understand what they need to build, but face complex challenges in data discovery, data governance, and data access. That is where Revelate becomes essential. You will need to be at ease operating in a lean, agile environment navigating long, complex enterprise sales cycles.
What You Will Do
Drive New Business: Identify, qualify, and pursue new sales opportunities within target accounts. You will own the entire sales cycle, from initial engagement and needs analysis to solution presentations and contract negotiations.
Become a Trusted Advisor: Cultivate lasting relationships with key decision-makers. You will develop a deep understanding of client needs and position Revelate 's Data Monetization solutions as the definitive key to achieving their business objectives.
Collaborate Effectively: Work closely with internal teams, including marketing and sales engineering, to ensure successful client onboarding and ongoing support.
Who You Are
Mercenary Drive + Empathy: You are hungry to win and possess a killer instinct, but you anchor it with baseline human decency and zero ego.
Startup Mindset: You are highly autonomous, happy to wear many hats, and thrive in ambiguity without needing hand-holding.
Genuine Collaborator: You engage authentically with the team. You build trust through transparency and shared wins-you are not a lone wolf, and your relationships aren't purely transactional.
Strong Communicator: You possess exceptional presentation, listening, and negotiation skills. You provide client-facing clarity without over-indexing on technical jargon.
Qualifications & Experience

• 6+ years of experience in B2B software or service sales with a consistent track record of generating leads, closing deals, and driving revenue.

• Demonstrated ability to identify and navigate large enterprise opportunities; experience closing 7-figure deals is a distinct advantage.

• Familiarity with data management, data platforms, or complex SaaS ecosystems (backgrounds in Financial Services, Exchanges, or Telecoms are also highly valued).

• A contrarian instinct: you see upside where others hesitate, and you are conviction-driven rather than consensus-led.

• Ability to effectively work remotely as part of a geographically distributed team.

• Willingness and ability to travel (approximately 10%) throughout the territory and to office locations when needed.

Why Revelate

At Revelate , you are not just selling software; you are building the future of data management by connecting people to data. We offer competitive benefits that include a comprehensive healthcare plan with medical, dental, and telemedicine to support your overall well-being. We also provide flexible hours, encouraging you to prioritize rest and recovery to maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Primarily remote (Montreal preferred), with travel to Montreal and client sites as required.

As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. title: Software Engineer (Mid-Level)
description:
​
Job Description - Software Engineer (Mid-Level)
Reports To - Engineering Manager
Summary
AxisCare is hiring a full-time, fully remote mid-level Software Engineer to join a team that's actively rethinking how software gets made.
Does this sound familiar? You're a skilled developer, and you can see where things are heading. The engineers who are just coders - the ones whose value came from being the person who could translate a spec into working code - are the ones AI is going to eat up first. You don't want that to be you. You want to get ahead of this by going deep on the things that still matter: system architecture, software design, and a real understanding of the problems you're solving. This is a senior-track position, and you'll find a team of senior and staff engineers deeply invested in your growth.
We're no longer building the car by hand, so to speak. We're building the factory that makes great cars, with humans in the loop where the human touch matters most. We want engineers who are genuinely energized by that shift and want to help figure out what it means in practice. (Read more about how we think AI is changing product development.)
You'll join an autonomous project team working on our market-leading home care SaaS, built on a PHP web stack with a React/TypeScript frontend. You'll ship real features for real agencies whose operations depend on our software.
There will always be a need for people who deeply understand our customers' most important problems, solve them with high-quality software, and run that software reliably in production. That's the work that endures, and that's the work we're hiring for.
No egos here. Just a handful of humble, talented, and conscientious builders who play well with others and work as a team to ship great things.
What This Role Actually Looks Like
You'll be building well-scoped features with oversight and mentorship from senior and staff engineers who are deep in this work. But a mid-level engineer is something very different in 2026 than it was two years ago. Concretely, we expect you to:

• Use AI as a core part of how you build. Not as a novelty or a copilot for autocomplete, but as a primary tool for prototyping, exploring, refactoring, writing tests, and shipping. We want to hear about the workflows you've developed, where agents work well for you, and just as importantly where they break down.

• Push the tools until they fail, then tell us about it. We're actively mapping the frontier. An engineer who tries something ambitious with AI, hits a wall, and writes up what they learned is more valuable to us than one who sticks to what's comfortable.

• Care about the problem, not just the code. Since writing code is no longer the scarce resource, understanding what we should build and why it matters to home care agencies matters more than ever. The engineers who thrive here get curious about customers and operations, not just tickets.

• Ship quality software that's easy to change. High-quality software is valuable now and easy to change later. Moving fast with AI only works if the work holds up.

• Manage your time to ship on time. Make meaningful progress on what matters and avoid getting lost in unimportant details. This is more important than ever when AI makes it easy to chase rabbit holes.

• Share what you're learning. This is a team sport, and the team only gets better if wins and lessons travel.

• Write well. Good writing matters here. Remote work demands it, clear writing is clear thinking, and clear thinking is how you get the biggest impact from AI.

What We're Looking For

• At least 2 years of professional experience on teams building web apps with the full PHP stack, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

• Experience building React apps in TypeScript

• Working knowledge of object-oriented programming and relational databases (MySQL or similar)

• Comfort with Git and collaborative development

• Demonstrated, substantive use of AI coding tools in real project

description:
About IONOS

At IONOS, we don't just manage servers - we shape the digital future for more than 6.2 million customers worldwide with our solutions. As Europe's leading hosting provider and a pioneer in independent cloud solutions, we are building next-generation infrastructure - from sovereign cloud architectures and high-performance GPU clusters to integrated AI automation tools.

Ready for your next step? Become part of IONOS and grow with us.

Our tax team of six, led by our Head of Tax, covers the tax matters of all group companies worldwide. To support us in Berlin or Karlsruhe, we are looking for a Tax Specialist (f/m/d)  who wants to work across the full range of our tax topics and is keen to build expertise in transfer pricing.

Tasks

• Preparing tax balance sheets and tax returns for the German group companies together with our colleagues.

• Support in preparing and maintaining our transfer pricing documentation (Master File, Local Files, CbCR), including functional and risk analyses.

• Contributing to the implementation and further development of intercompany transfer pricing guidelines and models and reviewing intercompany agreements in coordination with the business functions.

• Tax assessment of business transactions, contracts and restructurings.

• Advising business functions and subsidiaries on tax matters, and acting as contact person for our foreign entities on operational questions regarding the operational application of transfer pricing requirements.

• Helping us develop our Tax Compliance Management System further and digitalise our tax processes.

• Experience with SAP and common tax software, along with very good Excel skills.

title: Corporate Finance
description:
ROLE SUMMARY

We are seeking a sharp, execution-oriented Senior Finance Analyst in San Francisco, CA to own close, reporting, and modeling for our corporate finance function. This early role on the corporate finance team will play a pivotal role in building the FP&A foundation that supports a high-growth, consumption-based company.

This role will own the month-end close process, produce monthly and quarterly board reporting, run BvA and flux analysis for executive reviews, and play a key role in supporting our consolidated 3 statement modeling.

This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role for a finance professional who wants to operate at the center of a company’s financial story. You will work directly with finance leadership, Accounting, and cross-functional partners.

This role is ideal for a candidate who has 2-4 years of experience in investment banking, private equity / venture capital, public accounting, or corporate FP&A at a high-growth technology company. You should be expert-level in Excel and Google Sheets, comfortable building and maintaining complex financial models, and energized by the prospect of building something from the ground up.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Own the Monthly Close and Reporting Cadence

- Drive the monthly close process end-to-end, partnering closely with Accounting and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver timely, accurate, and decision-useful outputs

- Own monthly and quarterly reporting to the CFO and Board, translating financial results into clear narratives, key insights, and actionable takeaways.

- Lead variance analysis and management reporting, identifying the “why” behind results and helping drive performance discussions with the CFO and department leaders.

Maintain Our Financial Models and Reporting Infrastructure

- Support updates to the consolidated three-statement model, cash forecast, and long-range financial plan, ensuring leadership has a reliable view of runway, investment capacity, and growth trajectory.

- Partner with the People team to deliver accurate workforce reporting, headcount tracking, and hiring plan visibility.

- Support the implementation and ongoing administration of Pigment as our planning platform,  helping build the systems foundation for a public-company-ready finance function.

Operate Effectively in a High-Growth, Pre-IPO Environment

- Bring structure and rigor to a finance function that is being built from the ground up.

- Identify gaps in process, reporting, systems, or data integrity, and drive practical, high-ROI improvements that make the finance organization faster and more reliable.

- Operate with a high degree of ownership and judgment in an environment where historical data is imperfect and processes are still evolving.

- Own ad hoc analysis for the CFO, finance leadership, and cross-functional partners.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

Background & Experience

- 2-4 years of relevant experience, with experience in one or more of the following: investment banking, private equity or venture capital, public accounting (Big 4 preferred), or corporate FP&A / strategic finance at a high-growth technology company.

- Direct experience with month-end close, board reporting, and financial model maintenance is strongly preferred.

- Experience at a high-growth technology company and familiarity with consumption and SaaS metrics.

Technical & Analytical Skills

- Expert-level Excel and Google Sheets skills; able to independently maintain and extend complex, multi-layered financial models.

- Strong understanding of three-statement modeling fundamentals, BvA and flux analysis, and headcount and expense forecasting.

- Comfort working with imperfect data and translating it into structured assumptions and clearly documented outputs.

- Familiarity with Pigment or other planning and ERP systems is a plus.

Execution & Mindset

- High ownership mentality with a bias toward accountability, follow-through, and getting things done.

- Highly organized and process-orient

title: Mobile Phlebotomy Associate
description:

Mobile Phlebotomy Associate reports to Mobile Phlebotomy Manager and will work directly with Natera’s internal and external, domestic and international customers consisting of medical professionals, patients, and sales by assisting across a wide range of interactions.

Schedule:  Monday - Friday, 10am-7pm  CST.  The hourly rate starts at $21.50.   

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Deals directly with internal and external customers via telephone and electronic channels to obtain missing information needed for processing of submitted test samples based on assigned region. Necessary information includes:

• Requested tests to be processed

• Deals directly with internal and external customers via telephone and electronic channels to:

• Communicate test status per protocol to respective customers

• Schedule requests for mobile phlebotomy

• Placing kit/supply orders

• Tracking orders

• Respond promptly to internal and external customer inquiries and complaints regarding missing and delayed appointment, and other relevant inquiries

• Obtain and evaluate all relevant information to handle inquiries and complaints

• Direct or escalate requests and unresolvable issues as needed

• High School degree or equivalent required;

• Two- or Four-year undergraduate degree or certification preferred;

• At least 2 years prior customer service experience;

• Multi-lingual skills are a strong plus

•

• Ability to analyze, escalate, or resolve customer questions within established protocols

• Excellence in attention to detail and organization skills

• Ability to maintain professionalism when communicating with customers 

 

PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT:

• This position requires the ability to use a computer keyboard, communicate over the telephone and read printed material.

• Duties may require working outside normal working hours (evenings and weekends) at times.

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. title: Public Relations Manager
description:
Overview
Seismic is hiring a Public Relations Manager to help tell our story as we enter our next chapter as the Go-to-Market Performance company. Following our recently completed merger with Highspot, we’re bringing together new ideas, expertise and opportunities, and we’re looking for a strong writer and curious communicator to help shape what comes next.
Reporting to the Director of Global Communications, you’ll join a team comprised of PR, social media and content professionals within our broader Brand, Communications & Experience team. In this individual contributor role, you’ll help strengthen Seismic ’s reputation through compelling corporate and product storytelling, PR agency partnerships, awards and more.
You’ll collaborate with Marketing colleagues across Creative, Customer & Product Marketing, Events, Web, and more, supporting communications priorities across the business. This is an opportunity to build on your PR experience, take on new projects and sharpen your communications skills as Seismic grows.
Who you are:

• 4-7 years of public relations or communications experience, with a track record of developing stories, managing projects and delivering results.

• Excellent writing and editing skills, with and without AI support. You can build a strong draft on your own, adapt to different executive voices and use AI thoughtfully while maintaining accuracy, originality and quality.

• Strong news judgment. You recognize what makes a story worth telling, connect business priorities to timely conversations, and know when an idea needs a sharper angle.

• Curiosity and enthusiasm for PR. A great earned media placement makes your day. A news story sends you digging deeper. You follow a range of outlets, voices and formats and bring fresh ideas to your work.

• The ability to think ahead and prioritize. You anticipate needs, weigh competing business priorities and keep projects moving as circumstances change.

• Strong relationship-building skills. You earn trust across teams, with agency partners and with key stakeholders by listening closely, following through and offering thoughtful counsel.

• Executive presence and sound judgment. You’re comfortable working with senior leaders, asking thoughtful questions and presenting clear recommendations.

• Initiative and ownership. You bring ideas forward, work independently and follow projects through to completion, knowing when to make a decision and when to seek input.

• Strong time management and attention to detail. You manage deadlines, coordinate reviews and deliver accurate, polished work across multiple projects.

Nice to Have

• PR agency experience, or a mix of agency and in-house experience.

• Experience in technology or B2B software. We welcome PR professionals from other industries who bring strong communications skills and a desire to learn.

• Experience managing agency partners, leading awards programs or turning research findings into compelling stories.

What you'll be doing:

• Manage our PR agency partnerships: Serve as the day-to-day contact for Seismic ’s agencies in North America and EMEA, setting priorities, reviewing deliverablesand keeping work aligned with business goals.

•
Develop compelling PR materials: Write and edit press releases, messaging docs, contributed articles, executive thought leadership, media briefing documents and other communications that bring Seismic ’s story to life.

•
Lead our awards strategy: Identify opportunities that showcase Seismic ’s business, products, people and customer successes. Manage the awards calendar and develop strong submissions in partnership with teams across the company and our PR agency teams.

•
Turn research into stories: Support Seismic ’s original and third-party research initiatives, partnering with Content, Web and our PR agencies to uncover newsworthy findings and extend their reach through earned, owned and shared channels.

•
Build proactive media opportunities: Follow news, industry trends

title: Coding Quality Specialist
description:
Position Purpose: The Coding Quality Coordinator II is the journey level position within a job series that performs complex reviews of clinical documentation on inpatient and outpatient medical records. Validates accuracy of diagnostic and procedural coding, payment methodology, and reimbursement amount; develops written rationale of findings; responds to providers for resolution of appeals.
Key Details: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Sponsorship and future sponsorship are not available for this opportunity, including employment-based visa types H-1B, L-1, O-1, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, or CPT.

• Performs complex review of physician clinical documentation on inpatient and outpatient medical records.

• Performs quality analysis to determine accuracy of diagnostic and procedural coding, the correct interpretation and application of official coding guidelines and rules, and assignment of appropriate codes.

• Determines correct payment methodology and reimbursement.

• Develops case-specific written rationale to substantiate and communicate findings to hospital, provider, medical director, and peer review team.

• Conducts coding re-review for decisions that are based on coding convention and sequencing guidelines, not requiring medical review.

• Identifies clinical questions and refers cases to Medical Director.

• Responds to providers for resolution of appeals.

• Reviews updates to Coding Clinics, coding newsletters, and other professional resources to maintain up-to-date knowledge.

• Participates in ongoing in-service programs for coding-related or clinical education.

• Identifies and interprets patterns of possible fraud or abuse and refers to appropriate party for further evaluation and corrective action.

• Conducts periodic peer reviews.

• Other duties as assigned.

• Performs other duties as assigned.

• Complies with all policies and standards.

Education/Experience: AA, Health Information Technology, preferred. Two years experience with Diagnosis Related Groups (DRG), ICD-9-CM/ ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT, HCPCS coding.

License/Certification: One or more of the following certifications may be required: Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA), Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT), Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), Certified Coding Associate (CCA), or Certified Professional Coder (CPC)Pay Range: $56,200.00 - $101,000.00 per year

title: Senior Application Security Engineer
description:
About the Role
Are you a cybersecurity champion who thrives on embedding "secure by design" principles into cutting-edge cloud infrastructure and microservices? We are looking for a Senior Application Security Engineer to act as a trusted advisor, driving the evolution of secure product engineering from legacy data centers to AWS. If you want to own threat modeling automation, champion supply chain security, and influence engineering roadmaps in a high-scale environment, this is your next big move.
About the Client
Our partner is a tech company building product engineering across Fintech, iGaming, and Marketing. They turn innovative ideas into high-performing engines and launch them at scale. As their exclusive recruitment partner, Lionhires manages their full-cycle talent acquisition, connecting top-tier tech talent with this fast-growing ecosystem.
What You Will Do

• Design and implement robust security architecture spanning from cloud infrastructure down to the application layer, ensuring "secure by design" principles are met.

• Collaborate closely with product managers, architects, and developers to build and scale the security controls platform ecosystem.

• Validate and proof security implementations within infrastructure, application deployment manifests, and automated CI/CD pipelines.

• Define critical policies, controls, and capabilities to protect global products and environments.

• Build and automate declarative threat modeling to proactively identify and mitigate application risks.

• Oversee the product security strategy for migrating legacy data center workloads to the public cloud (AWS).

• Serve as a trusted cybersecurity advisor to engineering and product teams, participating actively in planning cycles and technical committees.

What You Bring

• Microservices Security: Proven experience analyzing and securing applications developed using JavaScript and TypeScript.

• DevSecOps Core: Hands-on experience integrating security scanning/tooling into CI/CD pipelines (GitLab, Jenkins) and utilizing Infrastructure-as-Code models (Terraform, Helm, or CloudFormation).

• Scripting Skills: Strong development experience in Python and Shell scripting.

• Modern Infrastructure: Deep familiarity with Docker and service mesh technologies (such as ISTIO).

• Security Assessments: Strong background in architecture/security reviews, threat modeling, and application risk mitigation within an Agile framework.

• Software Integrity: A rock-solid understanding of supply chain security, software integrity, and secure software delivery.

• Compliance & Privacy: Familiarity with industry regulations and frameworks (PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, NIST) and privacy laws like GDPR.

• Bonus Points: In-depth experience architecting secure services on Kubernetes/AWS and holding industry certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CCSK, CCSP, CEH).

What's in It for You

•
True Ownership: You will have the autonomy to influence our security roadmap and make architectural decisions that protect our production environments.

•
Impactful Work: Your work directly safeguards real-money flows and critical financial data, making a tangible difference in the security of our users.

•
Collaborative Culture: Join a cross-functional team of experts in engineering, fraud, and payments who value security and knowledge sharing.

•
Continuous Growth: We invest in your professional development through support for advanced certifications, conference attendance, and research time.

•
Competitive Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including competitive compensation, health coverage, and flexible working arrangements.

title: RunningMate General Manager
description:
Civitech is a public benefit corporation dedicated to creating a fairer and more equitable democracy by building the tools and infrastructure needed to increase civic participation, empower Democratic candidates to win, and support the success of progressive causes. Since its founding in 2019, over 1400 partners-a range of nonprofit organizations, national political committees, and individual campaigns-have utilized Civitech’s tools to reach tens of millions of voters to help create a more equitable and progressive democracy.
 

RunningMate is Civitech's newest product, focused on transforming how progressive campaigns compete and win. The General Manager role leads RunningMate as its own business unit - owning revenue growth as the single top priority, with the budget, people, and decision rights to drive it. The GM's primary job is understanding the space's complex market structure and charting a course through it to drive business success and impactful growth. They'll spend much of their time as RunningMate's primary ambassador to the market, and their first deliverable is building RunningMate's 2027 strategy and plan. Civitech is a remote-first company hiring within our current footprint of  27 states (AL, AK, CA, CO, DC, DE, FL, GA, HI, IL, MA, MD, MN, NC, ND, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, SD, TN, TX, VA, WA, WI, WY);  Civitech does have an office in Austin, TX.
 
It is important that our team reflects the diversity of the organizations we seek to serve. We strongly encourage women, people of color, LGBTQIA+ people, and others otherwise underrepresented in the technology sector to apply.
 
 
What You Will Do:
 
Lead the RunningMate business unit, a cross-functional team of approximately 10 people spanning Product & Engineering, Marketing, and Client Success & Partnerships; set clear priorities, align the team around shared goals, and ensure work across functions supports the broader business strategy.
Set the strategy for how RunningMate grows and wins in the market, including decisions around budget allocation, go-to-market investment, target customers and organizations, and where the team should focus its time and resources.
Own RunningMate’s P&L and overall business performance, with accountability for revenue growth, investment decisions, and the financial health of the business unit.
Align Product & Engineering, Marketing, and Client Success & Partnerships around a cohesive strategy, ensuring teams are working toward shared priorities rather than operating as separate functions.
Shape and prioritize the RunningMate product roadmap in partnership with Product & Engineering, incorporating market needs, customer feedback, competitive dynamics, and growth opportunities to strengthen RunningMate’s position in the market.
Serve as a primary ambassador for RunningMate within the political ecosystem, building and maintaining relationships with campaigns, state parties, C3/C4 organizations, partners, and other key stakeholders that can contribute to the business’s growth.
Develop and drive RunningMate’s annual business strategy, beginning with the 2027 planning cycle, translating long-term goals into clear priorities, investments, targets, and measures of success for the team.
About You:
 
6+ years of experience in progressive politics.
Strong knowledge of the Democratic political and campaign ecosystem, including an understanding of campaigns, state parties, campaign committees, C3 and C4 organizations, and how these organizations approach budgeting, targeting, and purchasing decisions.
Demonstrated experience owning and delivering against revenue goals, with accountability for the performance of a P&L, book of business, business unit, or revenue channel, ideally within a startup or growing organization.
Experience building and scaling a product, business, or revenue stream in an entrepreneurial environment, including navigating ambiguity, limited resources, and evolving priorities to achieve meaningful growth.

title: CRM Marketing Manager
description:
Money stress is the biggest productivity killer in the workplace - My Money Matters exists to change that. We're building an app that improves employees' finances automatically every pay day - giving them financial tools that directly improve their financial health with less effort.
Every pay day is an opportunity to build better money habits. We make it easy. Employees can accelerate retirement savings with tax-efficient pension top-ups, build a safety net effortlessly with auto savings, or access their already-earned salary ahead of pay day for emergencies.
For employers, fewer employees with money worries means more focus on work. We're trusted by major organisations including the NHS, and we're growing fast.
Reports to: Head of Marketing | Location: Hybrid, London
About the role
Employers choose us as an employee benefit, but we only succeed when their people use what we offer. We're looking for a marketer to own the journey that turns our million plus users into active, engaged members.
You'll own CRM and lifecycle marketing from first sign-up to long-term engagement, including our always-on email channel, our most successful channel for conversion. It's a hands-on role where you'll plan, build, send and optimise the communications that drive activation, cross-sell and retention.
What you'll do
You'll design and run the member journey end-to-end: onboarding, activation, cross-sell across our products, retention and reactivation. You'll build segments, write and test campaigns, and use the data to decide what to say, to whom and when.
On a typical day you might:

• Build an onboarding sequence for a newly launched employer

• Spot a drop-off between sign-up and first use, then test a fix

• Build next week’s always-on campaigns to existing members

What we're looking for

• Deep CRM expertise - 3+ years hands-on with at least one major CRM (We’re moving to HubSpot from Emarsys)

• Excellent copywriting - 2+ years writing crisp, persuasive consumer copy

• Data and testing - Confident with segmentation, A/B testing and reporting

• Start-up experience - You know the challenges that come with tight deadlines, competing priorities and doing stuff that hasn’t been done before

Bonus points

• Fintech experience - Experience in financial services or financial wellbeing, including awareness of financial promotions rules

• AI-workflows - Yes, we know. Still, everyone team member must know the difference between creating effective workflows and creating god-awful AI slop

• App-based marketing - You've built and optimised automated journeys for a consumer app, using push and in-app messaging alongside email to drive activation and engagement

The type of person you are

• You obsess over customer experience - You notice a clunky journey the way others notice a typo, and you can't leave it alone until it's fixed

• You sweat the small stuff - Subject lines, send times, a broken link in email four of six

• You care about everything - The member, the result, the quality of the work. Good enough isn't a phrase you use

• You're high agency - You don't wait to be told. You spot the problem, own it and get it live

• You get stuff done - You'd rather ship, learn and improve than polish a plan forever

Success in this role looks like
More members activating, using more of our products and staying engaged. You'll be measured on conversion between journey stages and on CRM's contribution to active users and revenue.

Stage 1 | People & Culture Call - An initial screening call to learn more about your experience, motivations and what you're looking for in your next role.
Stage 2 | Hiring Manager Interview - A 45-minute interview with the Head of Marketing to explore experience in more detail, and give you the opportunity to learn more about the team and what we're building.

title: Customer Service Representative (Freshdesk)
description:
Are you a natural problem-solver with a neutral accent?

As the next Customer Service Representative I , you won’t just be answering questions-you’ll be a vital advocate for customers, ensuring their inquiries are handled with professionalism and speed. We are looking for an empathetic communicator who thrives in a multichannel environment (phone, email, chat, and SMS) and is ready to tackle Tier 1 support challenges. If you are a technical investigator with a C1 communication level and a passion for motorcycles, your next career move starts here.

• Work Setup: Remote - Philippines

• Type of Contract: Full-Time

• Schedule/Hours: 9 AM - 5 PM EST, Mon-Fri (Night Shift)

• Equipment: Bring-Your-Own Device (BYOD)

Job Summary

The Customer Service Representative I is responsible for handling incoming customer inquiries via phone, email, or chat and resolving customer issues in a timely and professional manner. This role focuses on delivering accurate product information, ensuring resolution satisfaction, and supporting AI readiness through meticulous documentation.

What does a day in the life of a Customer Service Representative I look like?

• Multichannel Engagement: Respond promptly and professionally to inquiries via phone, email, chat, and SMS.

• Tier 1 Support Mastery: Handle high-priority tasks such as WISMO (Where Is My Order), order changes, refunds, and other basic queries.

• Customer Advocacy: Provide accurate information about products and services while maintaining a positive, empathetic, and professional attitude toward all customers and colleagues.

• Resolution & Follow-up: Resolve issues efficiently and follow up with customers to ensure their satisfaction.

• CRM Excellence: Properly and accurately document all customer interactions in the organization’s CRM.

• AI Readiness Support: Facilitate future AI deflection strategies through detailed documentation and process support.

• Collaboration: Partner with other departments as needed to ensure customer success is achieved.

• KPI Performance: Meet or exceed performance targets for all related KPIs while adhering to company policies.

What are the qualifications of a Customer Service Representative I?

• Experience: Previous customer service experience or an equivalent background.

• Communication: C1 Communications level is a hard requirement with a natural and neutral accent .

• Technical Savvy: Proficient in using computers and various software applications.

• Tool Proficiency: Hands-on experience with Freshdesk and Vonage (or similar tools) is required.

• CRM Knowledge: Previous experience with a CRM is preferred.

• Subject Matter Interest: A familiarity or interest in motorcycles is a "nice to have" to support easier engagement with customers.

Core Soft Skills Requirements

• Empathetic Problem Solver: You maintain a professional and empathetic attitude at all times, ensuring customers feel heard.

• Outcome Focused: You focus on resolving issues in a timely and efficient manner, ensuring resolution to the customer's satisfaction.

• Adaptable Learner: You continuously improve your knowledge of products, services, and processes through training programs and learning modules.

Ninja Perks and Benefits

• Competitive Compensation

• Adherence to government-mandated benefits.

• Retirement Savings Program with Company Matching.

• Life Insurance.

• HMO starting on Day 1

• Paid time off + birthday leave.

• Opportunities for skills training and personal and professional development.

title: Working Student (f/m/d) Sales Development
description:
About IONOS

At IONOS, we don't just manage servers - we shape the digital future for more than 6.2 million customers worldwide with our solutions. As Europe's leading hosting provider and a pioneer in independent cloud solutions, we are building next-generation infrastructure - from sovereign cloud architectures and high-performance GPU clusters to integrated AI automation tools.

What drives us is digital sovereignty for Europe and real impact for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) as well as large enterprises. We work in agile teams, rely on transparent structures, and believe that excellence and innovation only emerge through true team spirit.

Ready for your next step? Become part of IONOS and grow with us.

The Sales Development Team is part of IONOS B2B Cloud Marketing and supports new and existing customers as well as prospects with all questions regarding the IONOS CLOUD. As a Working Student in Sales Development, you will support our Sales Developers in the team and colleagues across our DACH sales organization. You will work independently, focusing on customer and lead interaction - from acquisition, potential identification, contact, and qualification, through to onboarding and further development of IONOS CLOUD customers.

Tasks

• Provide independent telephone consulting and pre-qualification for customers and prospects regarding the application possibilities of our B2B cloud solutions, aiming to inspire companies for our services.

• Communicate via phone, email, web chat, video conferences, personal meetings, and events with customers and colleagues.

• Document, maintain, and evaluate sales KPIs using CRM and other web-based systems.

Qualifications

• Enrolled student in Business Administration, Economics, Political Science, Computer Science, or a comparable field of study.

• Initial practical experience in sales and/or IT (e.g. through previous internships) is a plus.

• Enthusiasm for active phone outreach and strong communication skills.

• Ability to adapt quickly to different discussion partners and accurately identify their needs.

• Enjoy working in a diverse team, highly interested in IT, and eager to learn new concepts.

• Fluent in German (written and spoken); English language skills are an advantage.

Benefits

• Hybrid working model with flexible scheduling around your lectures.

• Subsidized canteen and various free drinks at select office locations.

• Modern office space with excellent public transport connections.

• Various employee discounts for activities, services, and products.

• Regular team and company events (e.g., summer and winter parties, workshops).

• Numerous training, learning, and professional development opportunities.

• Health and sports offers.

Application Note

We value diversity and welcome all applications - regardless of, for example, gender, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion, disability, age as well as sexual orientation and identity, physical characteristics, marital status or any other irrelevant factor subject to applicable law.

title: Assistente Vendite Part-Time – 3 mesi (m/f/x)
description:
Sei appassionato/a di skincare e vuoi vivere da vicino il periodo più vivace dell’anno in un marchio di skincare coreana? Per le festività natalizie stiamo cercando persone entusiaste e dedicate che si uniscano al team del nostro Flagship Store a Milano come Assistente Vendite!

Durante la stagione più intensa dell’anno, avrai un ruolo chiave nell’offrire esperienze eccezionali ai clienti e nel far conoscere la nostra routine di skincare K-Beauty. Se hai passione per la skincare, ottime capacità nel servizio clienti e interesse per la skincare coreana, vogliamo conoscerti!

DETTAGLI DELLA POSIZIONE

- Part-time, 20 ore settimanali distribuite su turni concordati

- Contratto a tempo determinato di 3 mesi, da novembre a gennaio

- Possibilità di proroga al termine del contratto in base alle esigenze aziendali (non garantita)

SU YEPODA

Siamo una start-up di K-Beauty con sede a Berlino, dedicata a portare il meglio della skincare e delle tendenze di bellezza coreane nel mercato europeo.

Le ritualità della skincare coreana sono note nel mondo della bellezza come l’arma segreta per una pelle sana e luminosa. In Yepoda crediamo nell’esperienza coreana, nelle sue tradizioni e nelle sue innovazioni, dando a tutti i nostri prodotti un tocco personale: le nostre formule sono 100% prive di sostanze nocive come siliconi e parabeni, cruelty-free, vegane e realizzate con amore in Corea dai nostri esperti di K-Beauty. I nostri prodotti sono disponibili online e, per la prima volta in modo permanente, nel nostro Flagship Store a Milano!

LE TUE RESPONSABILITÀ

Come Assistente Vendite ti occuperai della nostra community nel Flagship Store di Milano durante il periodo delle festività, offrendo la vera esperienza Yepoda. In particolare:

- Mentalità di servizio: accogliere e assistere i clienti, rispondere alle domande sui prodotti e offrire consigli personalizzati sulla skincare, anche nei momenti di maggiore affluenza.

- Conoscenza del prodotto: imparare rapidamente i nostri prodotti, gli ingredienti e le routine skincare per consigliare con sicurezza i clienti in base al tipo di pelle e alle loro esigenze.

- Vendite e regali: contribuire al raggiungimento degli obiettivi di vendita del periodo natalizio, aiutando i clienti a scegliere idee regalo e set, e proponendo prodotti complementari quando opportuno.

- Analisi della pelle: utilizzare lo skin analyser in store, interpretarne i risultati e consigliare la routine Yepoda più adatta.

- Visual merchandising: mantenere il negozio pulito e ordinato, rifornire gli scaffali e assicurarsi che i prezzi siano sempre chiari e leggibili.

- Feedback dei clienti: raccogliere i feedback per aiutarci a migliorare prodotti e servizio.

- Promozioni ed eventi: supportare promozioni stagionali, lanci ed eventi in store.

- Brand ambassador: rappresentare i valori di Yepoda e contribuire a far crescere la consapevolezza del marchio.

COSA CERCHIAMO

- Accogliamo candidature da profili con qualsiasi livello di esperienza, dalla prima esperienza nel retail a professionisti/e già affermati/e.

- Disponibilità per l’intera durata del contratto, a lavorare su turni, inclusi fine settimana e giorni festivi del periodo natalizio.

- Forte orientamento al servizio clienti.

- Ottime capacità comunicative e relazionali.

- Atteggiamento entusiasta e cordiale.

- Capacità di gestire più attività contemporaneamente in un ambiente retail dinamico, soprattutto nei periodi di picco.

- Ottima conoscenza della lingua italiana; una conoscenza intermedia dell’inglese è un plus.

- Passione per la skincare; interesse per la cultura e la skincare coreana è un plus.

- Cura della propria presentazione, in linea con gli standard Yepoda.

COSA OFFRIAMO

- Retribuzione: inquadramento CCNL Terziario, Distribuzione e Servizi (Confcommercio), IV livello. Retribuzione di circa €25.500 lordi annui per contratto full-time (40 ore settimanali), riproporzionata per 20 ore settimanali e per la durata del contratto, oltre a buoni pas

title: Tutor in der Lohnbuchhaltung (m/w/d) - 100% REMOTE
description:
Warum MOD?
MOD steht für eine Arbeitsweise, die auf Verlässlichkeit, Eigenverantwortung und fachlicher Weiterentwicklung basiert. Wir schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem du deine Kompetenzen gezielt einbringen und ausbauen kannst. Dabei arbeiten wir gemeinsam an klaren Zielen und legen Wert auf eine professionelle, kollegiale Zusammenarbeit.
Für diese Position suchen wir eine Person, die unsere Vision teilt und mit fachlicher Expertise dazu beiträgt, hochwertige Weiterbildung im Bereich digitale Lohnbuchhaltung und DATEV zu gestalten und umzusetzen.
Unsere Academy
Die MOD Academy verbindet strukturiertes Selbstlernen auf unserer digitalen Lernplattform mit interaktiven, praxisnahen Lehrformaten. Die Teilnehmenden erarbeiten sich Inhalte eigenständig anhand klar aufbereiteter Lernmaterialien und vertiefen diese in Live-Sessions, Group-Sessions und individuellen Tutorings.
Unsere Formate umfassen unter anderem:

• begleitete Selbstlernphasen mit Videos, Skripten, Übungen und Quizzes

• praxisorientierte Live-Sessions zu aktuellen Fachthemen und realen Anwendungsfällen

• moderierte Group-Sessions zur Vertiefung und zum fachlichen Austausch

• Skill-Tutorings zur Vermittlung ergänzender Methoden-, Tool- und Soft-Skill-Kompetenzen

Die Kurse sind modular aufgebaut, dauern in der Regel 4 bis 8 Wochen und ermöglichen eine flexible, individuelle Lernorganisation.
Aufgaben
Als Tutor/in in der Lohn-/Finanzbuchhaltung für den Kurs “ Payroll & Digitale Lohnbuchhaltung mit DATEV ” bist du gemeinsam mit dem Dozierenden für dieses Modulthema in unserer Academy verantwortlich. Dein Ziel ist es, unseren Teilnehmenden eine optimale Learning Experience zu bieten und sie professionell durch den Kurs zu begleiten, um ihnen ein erfolgreiches Bestehen der Weiterbildung zu ermöglichen. Hierzu gehören folgende detaillierte Aufgaben:

• Kurserstellung (Inhalte, Übungen, Tests) gemeinsam mit dem Dozierenden

• Einzelsessions mit den Teilnehmenden zu fachlichen Fragen

• Halten von Skill-Tutorings

• Abnahme/Bewertung von Abschlussprüfungen

• Aufgabenkontrolle und -bewertung

• Update der Kursunterlagen und Optimierung des Kurses

• Erstellung von neuen Übungen

• Koordination von Sessions und Terminen

• Support der Plattform-Produktmanager bei Kursupdates auf unserer Lernplattform

Qualifikation

• Du verfügst über mindestens 1-2 Jahre praktische Berufserfahrung in der Lohnbuchhaltung.

description:

OKX's Legal team provides legal advice and guidance to the company across all coverage areas and geographic locations, and supports business growth and development by working with all teams within the company to help them achieve their goals. We are a high-functioning, collaborative and fast-paced group of lawyers who enjoy the cutting-edge nature of our work and the digital assets industry.

 

Sitting in the Legal department, the Corporate Investigations team investigates fraud, misconduct and abuse committed against OKX. The team includes experienced investigators, among them former federal agents, and partners closely with the Compliance, Risk, Finance, and HR departments, colleagues in the Legal department, and business executives across OKX's global footprint.

Where an investigation warrants it, you will be responsible for bringing matters to the appropriate authorities in the US, EMEA and APAC, ensuring each case is built to a prosecutorial standard and supported through to any civil or criminal resolution.

 

We offer a competitive base salary and bonus structure as well as excellent benefits and an opportunity to work in a cutting-edge industry that will be the future of financial services. Extensive international travel on short notice expected in this role.
