title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer, Driving Product
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Driving Product Team

The Driving Product team owns Wayve's core end to end driving model, the algorithm that directly shapes how our vehicles behave on the road. This model already underpins production agreements with Nissan and Mercedes, with further OEM partnerships in the works, so the team's output is tied directly to Wayve's near term commercial milestones. The team is highly iterative: it looks at the top issues we see on the road, root causes them, and drives them out through data, model and evaluation changes, working closely with other teams across the business to resolve issues that span the model and vehicle interface.

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Lead the team iterating on L2 driving performance, balancing hands-on technical work with team leadership

- Diagnose the highest impact issues seen on the road, root cause them, and resolve them through data and model iteration

- Own changes to data recipes, model architecture, evaluation and release readiness for the driving model

- Partner with other teams to resolve cross-functional issues, including model and vehicle interface problems

- Act as one of the team's key hands-on developers, writing code and running experiments alongside directing the team's priorities

🧩 What you'll be working on:

- The end to end driving model that powers Wayve's L2 product and sits at the centre of our OEM partnerships with Nissan and Mercedes, with further partners in the pipeline

- Scaling the driving model's performance across different geographies and vehicle platforms while hitting performance and compliance KPIs

- Data led iteration cycles: using on road and off road evaluation to identify the biggest performance gaps and close them

- Cross-functional resolution of model and vehicle interface issues, working with specialists across the business

- Growing and shaping a small, high impact team (initially up to five people) as the driving model programme scales

👤 You should apply if:

- You're highly technical and hands-on, comfortable writing Python and doing model and data iteration yourself, not just directing others

- You've delivered deployed, production ML models, ideally in robotics or autonomous vehicles, with experience shipping and iterating on ML for embodied AI applications

- Alternatively, you've productionised ML models at another company and have experience delivering incremental improvements to a live system over time

- Your experience is production focused rather than primarily research or early stage exploration

- You want to keep doing deeply technical work, whether or not you've managed people before. We're looking for strong ICs or tech leads just as much as experienced managers, and are happy to ease the right person into managing a small team

🌱 Not ticking every box? That's totally okay! If you're passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚗 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars,

In this role, you will own raw material and packaging categories, drive aggressive margin expansion, and partner cross-functionally with R&D, Marketing, and Operations to commercialize high-growth product pipelines. The ideal candidate brings deep domain expertise in personal care contract manufacturing, technical formulation components, and robust operational governance from PO issuance to ERP data architecture.

Vendor Lifecycle Management

Strategic Sourcing & COGS Optimization

• Track, maintain, and audit capital tooling investments (injection molds, blow molds, custom line equipment) hosted at supplier and co-packer facilities. 

NPD Project Management & Commercialization

• Partner with R&D, Brand Marketing, and co-packer engineering teams to resolve technical transfer challenges, manage long-lead components, and guarantee on-time commercial launches.

• Drive daily cross-functional project timelines, set sample review milestones, and coordinate testing schedules between R&D, Quality, brand teams, and external co-packers. 

Purchase Order Management & Procure-to-Pay (P2P)

• Partner with Accounts Payable and logistics to manage consigned inventory, turnkey billings, and resolve 3-way invoice matching discrepancies efficiently.
